sources.title: Apple Support - macOS Ventura is compatible with these computers
sources.note: Apple's archived list of Mac models compatible with Ventura. It defines Apple's supported Mac model list and is not a compatibility statement for non-Apple PCs.

sources.title: Intel second-generation desktop Core, Pentium, and Celeron processor datasheet
sources.note: Includes Pentium G630 in the desktop Pentium G600 series. It is hardware documentation, not macOS compatibility evidence.

sources.title: Intel - List of Drivers for Intel Graphics
sources.note: Lists Pentium G630 in an Intel HD Graphics Windows driver group. This does not establish macOS support.

sources.title: Dortania OpenCore Install Guide - Hardware Limitations
sources.note: Current guide states Ventura drops pre-Haswell CPU support and discusses AVX2 requirements. It is community project guidance, not an Apple certification.

sources.title: Dortania OpenCore Install Guide - Desktop Sandy Bridge
sources.note: Lists macOS 12 Monterey as the last supported OS for the Sandy Bridge desktop guide and says the iGPU is officially supported only through macOS 10.13.

sources.title: Dortania GPU Buyers Guide - Legacy Intel
sources.note: Sandy Bridge 2XXX graphics section lists High Sierra 10.13.6 as the highest supported OS and names HD 2000, HD 3000, and HD P3000. Exact device mapping remains necessary.

sources.title: OpenIntelWireless - Compatibility
sources.note: Lists supported Intel Wi-Fi adapter families and directs readers to source files for exact PCI IDs. Check exact card and driver version.

sources.title: OpenIntelWireless - itlwm releases
sources.note: Release v2.2.0 explicitly added macOS Ventura support and notes Handoff is disabled on Ventura. The current v2.3.0 release notes Sonoma support.

sources.title: AppleALC - Supported codecs
sources.note: Current table v1.9.8, edited 2026-09-30, lists codec revisions and layouts. MinKernel values are Darwin kernel versions; the table explicitly labels 13 as macOS 10.9.

sources.title: Acidanthera - NVMeFix
sources.note: Describes targeted power-management and timeout-panic workarounds for some NVMe controllers. It does not establish universal SSD or storage-controller compatibility.
